addition.item: Added Cache admin submenu hub with Cache Rules, Cache Diagnostics and Cache Preview views
Added Cloudflare admin submenu hub with Clear Cache, Cloudflare Analytics and Cloudflare Rules views
Added read-only Cloudflare Page Rules and Firewall rules in administrator
Added Security Events and Security Center Insights to Cloudflare Analytics
Added automatic Vary response headers for multilingual sites and logged-in cache mode
Added Google Analytics admin expansion: 7-day, 28-day and Realtime overview views with refresh controls
Added full 15-locale language packs across the Utils suite and Administrator Tools extensions
Added Administrator Tools hub (com_devarttools) with Favicon Creator, Asset Table Repair, diagnostics and root text-file tools
Added Scheduled Tasks and console plugins for Asset Table Repair
Added Settings toolbar Back/Save/Save and Close, Administrator Tools settings header, and DevArt.gr footer links
Added missing Asset Repair ACL diagnostics language keys for JED Checker (15 locales)

change.item: First public release since 1.2.10 (intermediate 1.2.11–1.2.46 builds were not published)
Migrated legacy Backend Tools into the DevArt Utils suite package (pkg_devartutils)
Nested Favicon Creator and Asset Table Repair under Administrator Tools; hid them from the Components menu
Restyled Cache, Cloudflare, GA and Tools hub cards to match DevArt Article Tools styling
Updated Dashboard and hub header images; Dashboard header shown at natural size
Reordered Cloudflare Clear Cache actions into separated blocks (site cache, specific URL, Purge Everything, Test Connection)
Cached enabled cache rules and component params in the frontend DevArt Cache plugin with invalidation on changes
GA Realtime top pages use unifiedScreenName; GA cache files scoped by property ID with clear-on-settings-change
GA 7-day and 28-day views support manual refresh and force cache bypass
JED pre-release hardening: manifest metadata, Joomla HttpFactory transport, filesystem API, install scripts, GPL headers
Package-only Joomla update architecture with root update.xml and changelog.xml (Slider/Widgets aligned)
PHP minimum aligned to 8.3.0; Joomla 6+ only

fix.item: Fixed Clean Cache toolbar plugin corrupting JSON badge responses (System dashboard red X icons)
Fixed GA 7-day and 28-day breakdown tables (Top Pages, Countries, Devices, Traffic Sources)
Fixed Settings tabs by loading Bootstrap tab assets; Settings accessed via Tools hub
Fixed admin hub styling by loading component CSS through WebAssetManager with correct weight
Fixed suite child component autoload manifests and dropped Backend Tools migration logic
Fixed uninstall data retention so keep_data_on_uninstall is honored by the installer script
Injected the Clean Cache toolbar script before the final closing body tag instead of replacing every body marker
Preserved original query-string order and encoding when stripping tracking parameters for URL rule matching
Reduced cache cleanup debug log exposure by logging relative cache paths instead of absolute filesystem paths

security.item: Secured the GA Realtime AJAX refresh endpoint with administrator client check, CSRF token validation, and ACL enforcement
Hardened cache clean return URL handling to reject external open redirects
Secured cache rules export/import/delete/reorder with CSRF token validation and ACL checks
CSRF hardening: state-changing Rules and Settings actions now require POST token checks
Restricted Google Analytics OAuth token requests to the official Google HTTPS endpoint
Hardened filesystem cache cleanup to stay within allowed cache roots and skip symlink targets
Hardened debug response headers by stripping control characters from DevArt Cache diagnostic values
Restricted Settings save POST handling to an explicit field allowlist
Added devartutils.garealtime ACL action for granular GA Realtime access control

note.item: Public release replacing the previous public line at 1.2.10
Recommended update for all DevArt Utils installations

new.item: Added visual section headers across DevArt Utils administrator pages.
Added Disclaimer / Limitation of Liability section in Settings.
Added optimized database index for cache rules matching.

Optimized cache rules database access for future scalability.

Improved media asset handling inside package installation.

performance.item: Added optimized database index for faster rules lookup performance.
Reduced overhead for future large rule sets and high-traffic environments.
Prepared groundwork for additional cache rule optimizations in future versions.

No new security vulnerabilities introduced.
Added GPL license declarations in all XML manifest files.
Added GPL license headers in all PHP files.
Ensured full compliance with Joomla Extensions Directory (JED) requirements.

Prepared extension for official Joomla Extensions Directory submission.

Prepared future DevArt Utils releases to be delivered directly from GitHub Releases.
